pages.title: Dimensional Stabiliser
pages.text: A stabiliser that holds the number of dimensions in a region fixed while machines nearby try to change it. A dimensional stabiliser matrix sets the count, and a field emitter enforces it. Near it, corners look properly square.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Hyperdimensional machines kept bleeding extra dimensions into the lab. I built a stabiliser around a dimensional stabiliser matrix with a field emitter and hyperframe casing, and the room stayed three-dimensional.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Horizon Simulation.
